YCH Showcase - December 2025 by AlexanderPaupoff, journal

YCH Showcase - December 2025

Dec 8, 2025
YCH (Your Character Here) artists don't just create art; they ignite your imagination with boundless possibilities. With each stroke of their pencil or brush, they sketch a scene, a moment, a pose that invites you to envision your character within it. It's not merely a commission; it's a collaborative journey where you and the artist co-author an unforgettable experience for your character. Welcome to this monthly feature where we spotlight the exceptional talents of YCH artists and their inspired creations. We invite you to immerse yourself in the imaginative worlds they've crafted for characters like yours. And, who knows? You might just discover a space for your own character to shine within their art! @DemonicKingdom Community Quotes Like fire like ice! - Very intense mix of blue colors there. I'm really surprised how perfectly discernable and different every detail is despite using mainly blue, which also happens to be my favorite color. Keep to good work up! :> -

Tutorial: Baking Elisabeth's Gingerbread / Contest by Malintra-Shadowmoon, journal

Tutorial: Baking Elisabeth's Gingerbread / Contest

Oct 31, 2025
NEW - EXTENDED DEADLINE FOR ANOTHER MONTH - NEW (see the new deadline below behind the former date in paranthesis) Elisabeth's Gingerbread (Elisenlebkuchene) Where does the name Elisenlebkuchen actually come from? There is a legend in Nuremberg that says that Elisenlebkuchen was invented by a gingerbread baker around 1720. For a long time, Elisenlebkuchen was said to have healing properties. The legend of the gingerbread baker's daughter The legend has its origins in the illness of a gingerbread baker's daughter. He had lost his wife to a serious illness some time before. Now, as you can imagine, he was very worried about losing his daughter too. No doctor could help. In his great despair, he remembered that oriental spices were said to have healing properties. Since he had always used many of these oriental spices in his gingerbread bakery, he took courage again and came up with a new recipe for his gingerbread. This was made without flour and only with the highest quality

CLOSED The Home for the Holidays Contest Challenge

Nov 26, 2025
New Challenge for @DevNews Home for the Holidays A Contest Challenge to depict being Home for the Holidays, whether it is a Christmas Lighting on the Square of a Town, a gathering at someone's house in a festive setting, a neighborhood light display, a Holiday Party, greeting family for a celebration, sled riding with friends, ice skating amid Holiday decor or just lounging in front of a warm fire, how do you interpret being Home for the Holidays? Submit your entry to the Home for the Holidays folder at @DevNews ~ must be PG and undoubtedly Safe for Work! Accepted Entries are: Photography, Traditional and Digital Art (No AI) Entries must be NEW starting November 25, 2025 ~ All Entries should be submitted by the end of December 18th DA time, which is the Pacific Time Zone Voting by the Judges Begins on December 19th A Holiday can be any Holiday in December One Submission per Account (Entries go into the Home for the Holidays Contest Folder at @DevNews ) There will be Five (5)

Join DeviantArt's Ambassador program! by moonbeam13, journal

Join DeviantArt's Ambassador program!

Nov 28, 2024
DeviantArt is proud to announce a new opportunity for deviants to contribute to the community at a deeper level! The Ambassador program is designed to give deviants a chance to bring artists together, offer ways for artists to hone their skills or try new things, and help shape the future of the community.  Deviants eligible to participate in the Ambassador program are those who are co-founders or top contributors of official DeviantArt groups or affiliated groups. There are many factors that determine whether or not deviants might be a good fit for the Ambassador program, but all potential ambassadors should: Frequently run or organize community events Routinely be active participants in their community Consistently encourage and cheer on other artists Ambassadors will have direct contact with and support from DeviantArt team members when hosting events and challenges, to help their projects thrive.   Are you ready to be a community ambassador? Fan Art Friday - The Grinch by moonbeam13, journal

Fan Art Friday - The Grinch

Dec 5, 2025
This week, we’re heading to the snowy peaks of Mount Crumpit to shine a spotlight on everyone’s favourite festive grouch! From classic Dr. Seuss illustrations to Jim Carrey’s chaotic brilliance and the more recent animated twist -- The Grinch has stolen our hearts (and occasionally Christmas) in so many iconic ways. Today we’re celebrating the incredible fan artists who capture his mischievous charm, his sneaky smirks, and maybe even his heart that’s grown three sizes. “I’m not just a Grinch. I’m THE Grinch!” — The Grinch (2018) “Maybe Christmas doesn’t come from a store. Maybe Christmas, perhaps, means a little bit more.” — How the Grinch Stole Christmas Explore previous editions in our Fan Art Friday Collection Want to see your favourite fandom featured?
